title: `ClassDB.is_parent_class` doesn't work with script classes
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.beta [b432e108d50fd436d04d0f79b0a7cab8985032f7]

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (b432e108d) - Fedora Linux 42 (Adams) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 60.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

Given the following scripts:

```gdscript
# my_resource.gd
class_name MyResource extends Resource
```

```gdscript
# main.gd
extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
    if ClassDB.is_parent_class("MyResource", "Resource"):
        print("MyResource is considered to derive from Resource")
    else:
        print("MyResource is NOT considered to derive from Resource")
```

You will currently see `MyResource is NOT considered to derive from Resource` be printed.

Seeing as how other exposed methods in `ClassDB` seem to explicitly accommodate for script classes (e.g. `ClassDB.can_instantiate`) this seems like a bug/oversight.

This also happens to break the functionality of certain code paths in the engine that rely on `ClassDB::is_parent_class`, such as when passing a script class name as a type hint to `ResourceLoader.load`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP
2. Run the main scene
3. Observe the output

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[script_is_parent_class_2025-08-22_18-40-50.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21941751/script_is_parent_class_2025-08-22_18-40-50.zip)
